# ePainAssist

> ePainAssist is a comprehensive medical reference and health information portal specializing in pain management, medical conditions, injuries, and health guides across multiple body systems and specialties.

The site provides detailed information on pain types, management strategies, sports injuries, genetic disorders, infectious diseases, cancer care, allergies, and specialized health guides for women and children. ePainAssist serves as a centralized resource for understanding symptoms, conditions, and treatment options across diverse medical domains.

## Key Topics

- Pain Management
- Sports Injuries
- Medical Conditions
- Health Information
- Genetic Disorders
- Infectious Diseases
- Cancer Information
- Nervous System Disorders
- Women's Health
- Pediatric Health
- Allergies
- Dermatology
- Dental Health
- Injury Prevention
- Condition Overview

## Pain & Pain Management

- [Pain Information Center](https://www.epainassist.com/pain-information-center): Central hub for pain types: abdominal, headache, back, eye, joint, chest pain
- [Pain Management Information Center](https://www.epainassist.com/pain-management): Pain types and management: burning, shooting, stabbing, colicky pain

## Sports Injuries & Physical Trauma

- [Sports Injuries Information Center](https://www.epainassist.com/sports-injuries): Sports injury archive hub covering ankle, knee, hip, wrist injuries
- [Ankle Injuries](https://www.epainassist.com/sports-injuries/ankle-injuries): Ankle injury guide: sprains, fractures, Achilles tendon, peroneal issues
- [Knee Injuries](https://www.epainassist.com/sports-injuries/knee-injuries): Knee injury guide: patellar dislocation, sprain, contusion, synovitis
- [Hip Injuries](https://www.epainassist.com/sports-injuries/hip-injuries): Hip injury reference: bursitis, dislocation, tendonitis, labral tear
- [Wrist Injuries](https://www.epainassist.com/sports-injuries/wrist-injuries): Wrist injury reference: carpal tunnel, fractures, sprains, tendonitis
- [Pelvic, Groin, Buttock Pain](https://www.epainassist.com/sports-injuries/pelvic-groin-buttock-pain): Pelvic, groin, buttock pain guide: sports hernia, femoral hernia reference
- [Personal Injuries](https://www.epainassist.com/personal-injury): Personal injury guide: auto/work accidents, disability, compensation info

## Specialized Medical Conditions

- [Cancer Information Center](https://www.epainassist.com/cancer): Cancer pain management and treatment planning information center
- [Genetic Disorders Information Center](https://www.epainassist.com/genetic-disorders): 30+ genetic disorders including Fabry's disease, galactosemia reference
- [Nervous System Information Center](https://www.epainassist.com/nerves): Nerve diseases: dysautonomia, shingles, Guillain-Barré syndrome guide
- [Infectious Diseases](https://www.epainassist.com/infectious-diseases): Bacterial, fungal, viral infections, measles, stings and bites overview

## Health by Body System & Region

- [Face, Mouth and Throat Pain Information Center](https://www.epainassist.com/face-mouth-throat): Face, mouth, throat diseases including trigeminal neuralgia, throat cancer
- [Oral Health Information Center](https://www.epainassist.com/oral-health): Dental care: teeth grinding, gingivitis, cavity pain, tooth decay guide
- [Ear / Eye](https://www.epainassist.com/ear-and-eye): Navigation hub for ear and eye pain conditions and health information
- [Skin Problems](https://www.epainassist.com/skin-problems): Dermatology reference guide for skin conditions and health information

## Population-Specific Health Guides

- [Women's Health Guide](https://www.epainassist.com/womens-health-guide): Navigation hub for women's health conditions and medical information
- [Children's Health Center](https://www.epainassist.com/children): Kids health, safety information, and pediatric health conditions guide

## Allergies & Immune Health

- [Allergy Information Center](https://www.epainassist.com/allergies): Comprehensive allergy guide covering cockroach, latex, pet, seasonal allergies
